page.layout: One printed page: an engraved coat of arms with two supporters (figures standing either side) and a crest above, centred on the page. No text block. A digitiser's "Digitized by Google" stamp at the lower right is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page carries only an engraving of a coat of arms with two standing figures as supporters and a helm and crest above; no printed words are legible. The image is very dark, so the shield's charges cannot be made out. The grey rectangle at the top right is a scan edge or stain, not print. The "Digitized by Google" mark at the lower right is the digitiser's banner and is left out.
